incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: auth-token-validate service — P1: 10% request failures (401) across prod-us/prod-eu. Pager: PD-12345. Please ack.
pagerduty: Incident PD-12345 triggered, auto-escalation in 6m.
alex (sre): acked — oncall
alex (sre): looking at logs, lots of "token validation failed: kid not found" from auth-signer-*.prod
natasha (auth): seeing same, jwks endpoint returns 200 but keys list doesn't include new kid. last deploy ~10m ago.
sam (infra): did key rotation go out with the deploy? checking keymanager logs...
sam (infra): `kubectl get pods -n auth` -> auth-signer-0/1/2 Running, checking logs
maria (oncall): prod-eu error rate + latency spike. CS getting tickets about 401s during login flows.
natasha (auth): log snippet:
```
ERROR auth-signer/handler.go:142 token validation failed kid="k_2026_03" err="kid not found in JWKS"
WARN jwks-sync/controller.go:78 last-sync=2026-03-14T01:12:03Z source=keymanager
```
sam (infra): keymanager shows 504 to KMS for last rotation attempt, looks like network failure to kms-eu for that job.
alex (sre): mitigation options: 1) force JWKS fallback to previous key (accept old kid) 2) rollback signer deployment to pre-rotation image 3) temporarily route auth traffic to prod-us if eu is impacted
natasha (auth): prefer rollback + requeue rotation after KMS fix. I can roll back signer image 2 -> 1
maria (oncall): CS: informing customers, please provide ETA and affect list. I'll post status page update: "Partial auth failures for EU users"
priya (oncall): I'm taking over exec of rollback if you want natasha — can do immediate k8s rollout undo
natasha (auth): pls do, command:
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/auth-signer -n prod --to-revision=3
```
priya (oncall): running now...
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout undo started for auth-signer prod -> revision 3
priya (oncall): pods terminating -> new pods coming up
sam (infra): also adding temporary JWKS cache refresh across edge caches: `curl -X PURGE https://edge.jwks.prod/*`
alex (sre): PagerDuty: acknowledged PD-12345 by alex at 01:18 UTC
pagerduty: PD-12345 status: acknowledged (alex). Next escalation window 0h5m.
priya (oncall): rollback complete, health checks green, error rate dropping
maria (oncall): CS: updated status page: "Partial auth failures affecting EU logins. Mitigation in progress; some requests may see 401s."
cs-rep: getting fewer tickets now, some customers confirm restored.
natasha (auth): confirm logs show kid errors cleared; jwks now includes expected keys again.
alex (sre): closing PD-12345 on our side? want to keep incident open for followup
pagerduty: PD-12345 resolved by priya at 01:33 UTC
alex (sre): not closing Slack thread — will transition to postmortem and RCA. Assigning to natasha for root cause and sam for infra remediation
natasha (auth): initial RCA: key rotation attempted but KMS regional endpoint failed causing incomplete key publication -> signer deployed with new kid but JWKS entry missing in some regions
sam (infra): action items: add retry logic to keymanager publication, add pre-deploy check for jwks presence, alert on jwks-mismatch
priya (oncall): Handoff to night oncall priya -> priya will watch until 04:00 UTC. Summary for next oncall: PD-12345; rollback done; customer impact EU logins; root cause likely KMS network blip during rotation; postmortem assigned.
alex (sre): :white_check_mark: Thanks all. I'll create incident ticket and link to this thread. Followups: postmortem in 48h, notify legal if any SLA hit.
incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 | summary saved to /incidents/PD-12345
maria (oncall): marking channel read. If anything new, @priya
priya (oncall): ack — watching until 04:00 UTC
